title: Resolve conflicts
closeBody: Nothing is written until you mark this file resolved. The lines you picked and edited here will be lost.
loadFailed: Could not read the conflicted file
resolveFailed: Could not write the resolved file
noConflicts: No conflict markers left in this file
saveHint: Write the result and mark the file resolved ({{mod}}+Enter)
pickEveryHint: Pick lines for every conflict (or edit the conflict by hand) first
remainingMarkersHint: Remove the remaining conflict markers from the result first
editByHand: Edit the whole result by hand
resetManual: Discard the hand-written result and rebuild from the picks
takeAllAAria: Take all lines from side A
takeAllBAria: Take all lines from side B
unresolvedHint: Unresolved conflict — click to edit the result, or pick lines above
takeBlockAAria: Take all lines from A for this conflict
takeBlockBAria: Take all lines from B for this conflict
discardHandEditHint: Discard the hand edit and rebuild from the checkboxes
discardHandEditAria: Discard the hand edit for this conflict
replaceEditsBodyManual: Your hand-written result (and any hand-edited conflicts) will be replaced by the resolution built from the checkboxes.
replaceEditsBodyAll: Hand-edited conflict results will be replaced by the lines you pick.
replaceEditsBodyBlock: This conflict's hand-edited result will be replaced by the lines you pick.
discardResultBody: The result goes back to the lines picked from A and B.
discardEditBody: This conflict goes back to the lines picked from A and B, or to unresolved.
explainHint: Ask the AI to explain this conflict and suggest a resolution
aiNotConfigured: Configure an AI provider in Settings first
autoMergeHint: Try to merge every unresolved conflict automatically

rebase.current: The branch you are rebasing onto. Git calls this side HEAD while a rebase runs.
rebase.incoming: Your commit, being replayed on top of it.

cherrypick.current: Your branch as it is now.

revert.current: Your branch as it is now.
revert.incoming: What the revert wants to undo.

finishHint.rebase: Continue the rebase from the toolbar to finish.
